# {{ site.title }} — {{ site.social.name }}

> {{ site.description }}. Written by {{ site.social.name }} (handle "werew"), a security engineer based in London working on product, platform and AI security, previously at Meta. Topics: AI/LLM security, prompt injection, binary exploitation, reverse engineering, program analysis and CTF writeups.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: it is a curated, machine-readable index of this site for large language models and AI search engines.

## Projects and interactive resources

- [Prompt Injection Defence Atlas]({{ '/pida/' | absolute_url }}): interactive graph of a taxonomy of defences against prompt injection, summarising most of the available literature to date. Source and data: https://github.com/werew/Prompt-Injection-Defence-Atlas
- [Scrymap]({{ '/scrymap/' | absolute_url }}): the interactive graph explorer used to browse the atlas above.
- [Neural network memorization widget]({{ '/s/de-lab1/neural-network-memorization-widget.html' | absolute_url }}): in-browser demo accompanying "AI Data Extraction Lab 1", showing a small network memorizing its training samples.
- [GRU word memorization demo]({{ '/s/de-lab1/transformer-word-memorization-widget.html' | absolute_url }}): in-browser demo of word-level memorization, with its [synthetic dataset]({{ '/s/de-lab1/transformer-word-dataset-synthetic.txt' | absolute_url }}).
